candidates.title: Will Lorenzo Musetti win at least 3.5 more games than Ugo Humbert?

candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Lorenzo Musetti vs Ugo Humbert professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Quarterfinal. candidates.title: Stefon Diggs receiving yards ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.0025 per receiving yard recorded by Stefon Diggs during the Washington vs New York G Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 12, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.0025 per receiving yard constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 400 yards. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 80 receiving yards pays Yes $0.20 and No $0.80; 200 yards pays Yes $0.50 and No $0.50; zero yards pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.
